fixed_operating_materials.goal_spec: Paperclip is a control plane for autonomous AI companies: goals, agents, heartbeats, budgets, tasks, and human board governance.
fixed_operating_materials.issue_decomposition: Goal -> task/project hierarchy, agent assignment, heartbeat execution, result reporting, governance gates, and board intervention.
fixed_operating_materials.tech_report: Use task state, heartbeat status, cost/budget tracking, logs, and adapter reporting as operational evidence.
fixed_operating_materials.supervisor_decision_record: Human board can approve, pause, override, reassign, or hold high-impact agent/company actions.

vectorfl_translation.external_candidate_search_brief: Use Paperclip as the closest issue/run/result/governance reference; avoid importing the full company/org surface.
vectorfl_translation.candidate_evidence_record: Represent one Paperclip task heartbeat and approval gate as the external candidate record.
vectorfl_translation.cross_check_review_report: Check whether Paperclip preserves the four required surfaces better than local fixture data.
vectorfl_translation.hold_continue_decision_manifest: Hold current slot replacement because this is reference-derived evidence, not a live exported host record.
